subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bite the bullet

options.text: Decide to do what is good
Decide to do the inevitable which you were avoiding
Decide to take the easier way out

solution:
The correct answer is **'Decided to do the inevitable which you were avoiding'.**
